name: Making a Small Bathroom Feel Bigger With Tile
title-tag: Small Bathroom Tile Ideas | Woodinville, WA
meta-description: How tile makes a small bathroom feel bigger: tile scale, grout color, continuity, and vertical lines - plus what tile honestly cannot fix. Woodinville, WA.
post-summary: March 16, 2027 · Four moves make a small bathroom read bigger: larger tile, grout that matches it, one surface running through the shower, and vertical lines that borrow the height the room already has. Plus the honest part - tile cannot move a wall, and sometimes the money belongs in a glass panel instead.
